deltachat-android.description:
Delta Chat is a free, open-source messenger for private conversations, groups, and communities. Built on decentralized communication technology, it offers easy onboarding without requiring a phone number and supports secure messaging across Android, iOS, and desktop devices.

Exchange messages, photos, videos, files, and voice recordings with end-to-end encryption. Create group conversations, use multiple chat profiles, and connect additional devices. QR-code invitations and mutual consent help keep unwanted contacts out of your conversations.

Delta Chat also supports interactive tools and games through WebXDC apps that can run directly inside chats, including shared calendars, lists, and collaborative activities. Voice and video calling, reactions, message editing, and saved messages add convenience to everyday communication.

Its decentralized architecture lets users communicate through independent relays and compatible servers instead of relying on a single central provider. You can choose your own infrastructure or use the straightforward default setup.

Delta Chat is developed by a community of open-source contributors and distributed under the GNU General Public License version 3 or later. An internet connection is required for message delivery.
